result.summary: Slot a passes at 3/3 with seed 5 struck. Its core is day_centroid(sqrt(Volume)), with every control |ρ| at or below 0.14, and its periphery adds a limit-lock exclusion screen, the co-movement of volume timing with intraday direction, and a persistent-vs-transient split. The table also strikes seeds 8 and 13, so 10 seeds remain. Slot b goes back for a rewrite at 2/2. The table shows its local-price × volume construct is mostly a rewrite of the 20-day reversal control (rev 0.61–0.65) and of head +0.58's day_wmean(Ret, Volume), which falsifies the PI's prediction of rev 0.1–0.35. I struck 4 and 7 (the same quantity with longer windows), 11 (the impact measure drops direction) and 12 and 13 (raw confounded controls), so only seeds 9 and 10 are left. The R variant has no bad part: it is an equal-weight merge of two existing heads, with ρ about 0.90 against each, so it scores 2 and fails.
